scripts.render:build: npm install && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/auth/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/catalog/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/auth/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/catalog/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm run prisma:migrate:auth && npm run prisma:migrate:catalog
scripts.prisma:push: npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/auth/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/catalog/schema.prisma
scripts.seed:all: npm run seed:admin && npm run seed:products
scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run seed:all
